items.title: Uniform growth of canonical volume on Hilbert modular torsion-level covers over varying totally real fields
items.author: Soheil Memariansorkhabi
items.difficulty_reason: The geometric canonical-volume theorem combines Hilbert modular cusp/toroidal geometry, non-thin subvarieties, hyperbolic injectivity-radius and volume estimates, Hodge/Griffiths line bundles, and bigness/positivity to force growing birational canonical volume uniformly in the real multiplication field. The explicit original M(n,v), compactification and interior-intersection hypotheses are retained. It is independent of the old arithmetic point-sparsity remark and is not a new count for that conclusion.

primary.label: complete original Main theorem with uniform explicit level threshold and canonical-volume conclusion

proof_spans.label: original torsion-order interpretation and complete canonical-volume main proof

contexts.label: complete original modular/toroidal setup, Hodge preliminaries, cusp/core geometry, hyperbolic and canonical-volume estimates
original general-type, torsion and rational-point sparsity applications retained as uncounted context
